description.value:
"You are not an animal that learned to talk. You are a story the world made into a person because it needed you in the room."

Folklore Presence. 1/Soma Break, when you first meet a community, decide whether the rumors about you arrived first. If yes, reroll the lowest die on your first Diplomacy (Presence) or Intimidation (Presence) check with anyone in that community (your choice which skill, declared when you roll). The rumor is not always flattering — the GM gets to colour it.

Wasteland Adapted. Reroll the lowest die on defense checks against disease and environmental poison. You can subsist on rations that would sicken most humans (spoiled meat, swamp water, mushroom flesh).

Survivor's Instinct. 1/Soma Break, when you would drop to 0 Integrity, you may instead drop to 1 Integrity and gain one level of Stress.

Cryptidkin Subspecies. This heritage preserves the original UUID for Furrykin while converting it from a species-root with five sub-clades into a single flexible Cryptidkin subspecies.

“You are not an animal that learned to talk. You are a person the world made with fur because it needed you to survive.”

Furrykin. You are anything fur-bearing the world decided to make people out of. Talking badger, cunning fox, stoic bear, watchful rabbit, the uncle-shaped thing the trappers call Bigfoot—all valid. Size and frame are flexible; the instinct is not.

Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Cryptidkin).

  • Size. Small or Medium (choose at creation; Medium Furrykin can describe themselves as “large and shaggy” without mechanical change—Bigfoot-scale creatures still move and fight at Medium).

  • Speed. 6 squares

  • Subspecies Lean. No fixed stat lean. Your frame is your business—the Tier powers adapt to how you play it.

Core: Folklore & Frame

At creation you gain Folklore & Frame (Folklore Presence, Wasteland Adapted, Survivor’s Instinct).

Wildframe & Instinct (Furrykin Extras)

  • Wildframe. Your body is built for a world that bites back. You already reroll the lowest die on checks against disease and environmental poison (from Wasteland Adapted); as Furrykin, you also reroll the lowest die on Body defense checks to resist Stress.

  • Keen Sense. Choose one: Keen Smell, Keen Hearing, or Keen Sight. You reroll the lowest die on Perception checks relying on that sense.

  • Frame Choice. Choose one narrative frame at creation: Predator (bite or claws count as unarmed strikes that deal 1d6 instead of 1d4), Forager (trained in Athletics), or Brute (count as one size larger for carrying, shoving, and grappling).

Furrykin Tier Powers

You gain Tier I at creation, then Tier II (5), Tier III (11), Tier IV (17). Tier powers previously split across Felid / Leporid / Mustelid / Ursid / Vulpin are unified; choose flavor at the table without mechanical separation.

advancement.title: Furrykin Tier I
advancement.hint: Gain your Furrykin Tier I subspecies power (maps to legacy Wildframe & Instinct grant).

description.value:
“Your body is built for a world that bites back. So is your patience.”

Wildframe. Add your tier to Body defense checks made to resist Stress.

Keen Sense. Choose one at character creation: Keen Smell, Keen Hearing, or Keen Sight. You reroll the lowest die on Soul (Perception) checks that rely on that sense.

Frame Choice. Choose one narrative frame at character creation; it is permanent.

  • Predator. Your unarmed strikes (bite or claws) deal 1d6 instead of 1d4 and count as natural weapons.
  • Forager. You gain a skill rank in the Athletics skill. If you already have it, you may choose another skill from the Cryptidkin list (GM adjudicates).
  • Brute. You count as one size larger for the purposes of carrying capacity, push, drag, lift, shove, and grapple.

"You're not the hero. You're the reason the heroes don't trip over each other."

The Harmony Marshal runs on Surge like everyone — but yours arrives sideways: when an ally within 6 squares lands a surging roll (an exploding 10), the brilliance resonates into you and you bank a Surge too (+1, max +2/round). The party's best moments are your fuel; you spend them feeding the party back. Your tier powers are Surge spends, and the rerolls auto-fire now — no GM bookkeeping:

The Mandate (spent via Surge)

  • Rallying Words (1) — an ally banks a reroll-lowest on their next roll.
  • Ease Attrition (2) — heal an ally and clear one condition.
  • Rally to Me (2) — an ally banks a reroll and frees a reaction.
  • Unity Flourish (3) — every ally within 6 squares banks a reroll.
  • Conductor's Crescendo (5) — the whole line banks a reroll and each clears a condition.

The strategic layer endures out of combat — Attrition Easer, Loyalty Steward, and Unity Conductor still move Soft Power, attrition, and hex loyalty on the campaign turn. In a fight, though, you are a reroll engine: the dice obey you because you asked nicely, at exactly the right moment.

Harmony Initiate. You are a designated Harmony asset for your Domain.

  • You gain a skill rank in Diplomacy (Presence) and Insight (Soul) (handled by the Harmony Marshal class traits).
  • When you are the active Harmony Marshal for a Domain, that Domain’s Soft Power generation increases by 10% (rounding in your favor). The GM can apply this as a +10% modifier or as a small bonus whenever it would meaningfully matter for the current campaign scale.
  • This feature is Bad Eden-only and interacts with your Domain sheet’s Soft Power channel.

Silver Tongue Protocol. You have rehearsed, iterated, and field-tested the art of getting people to actually talk.

  • Whenever you make a Diplomacy (Presence) or Stealth (Intrigue) check, you can treat a rolled result of 8 or lower on the 2d10 as a 9 instead. You can use this feature a number of times per Soma Break equal to your Presence value (minimum once).
  • In Parley, you can spend one use of this feature to reroll the lowest die on a single Influence roll.

(The Active Effect below also gives you a small numeric edge on Diplomacy (Presence) and Stealth (Intrigue) checks as a quality-of-life bonus.)

Peacekeeper's Poise. Your presence steadies people at the exact moment everything could go sideways.

  • When initiative is rolled, you can choose up to a number of creatures equal to your Presence value (minimum one) within 6 squares of you. Each gains temporary Integrity equal to your Presence value + your tier.
  • You can use this feature a number of times per Soma Break equal to your tier.

description.value:
"No one breaks."

Mode: Persistence

Resolve is stubbornness elevated to a tactical doctrine. Your Surge spends keep people standing past the point they should have fallen — shrugging off fear, refusing the killing blow, and once a fight, refusing a death outright.

Doctrine (spent via Surge)

  • Hold the Line (1) — clear Shaken off an ally and hand them a reroll. No one breaks.
  • Second Wind (3) — ward an ally: the next hit that would drop them holds them at 1 Integrity.
  • None Lost (5) — refuse a death: restore a fallen ally to half Integrity and ward them. Once per fight. Not this one. Not today.

Out-of-combat: Measured Command, Rally the Quiet, Where the Front Is, Calm Push, Steel & Velvet and the Unbreakable Front remain the strategic flourishes.

Cryptidkin.

“Every settlement has a story about you. None of them are accurate. All of them are useful.”

Cryptidkin Core Traits

  • Creature Type. Humanoid (Cryptidkin).

  • Size. Small or Medium (set by subspecies).

  • Speed. 6 squares (subspecies may override).

  • attributes. Your background determines your attribute increases; Cryptidkin does not grant fixed bonuses. Subspecies lean expressed through Tier powers.

Folklore Presence. When you first encounter an NPC group, the GM chooses (or rolls) whether you are met as omen, trophy, or legend. It is never neutral. People have heard of your kind. They are almost always wrong, and that is almost always useful.

Wasteland Adapted. You reroll the lowest die on checks against disease and environmental poison. You ignore the first nonmagical environmental hazard you encounter each turn (heat, cold, radiation taint, wind shear, fume pockets).

Survivor’s Instinct. When you roll initiative, you can choose to know the position of the nearest exit, the nearest threat, or the nearest ally within 12 squares You cannot be surprised while conscious.

Subspecies. Choose one Cryptidkin subspecies (Chupacabra, Jackalope, Furrykin). Your subspecies grants Tier powers as you level (Tier I at creation, then 5/11/17).

Rallying Speech. You can deliver a short, targeted speech that makes people remember why you’re here.

  • As a bonus action, choose one creature other than yourself within 6 squares who can see or hear you. That creature gains a bonus to the next attack roll, attribute check, or defense check it makes before the start of your next turn. The bonus equals your Presence value (minimum +1).
  • You can use this feature a number of times per Soma Break equal to your tier.

Read the Room. You have an instinctive feel for the emotional geometry of conversations.

  • When you make an Insight (Soul) or Perception (Mind) check to gauge mood, detect Stealth, or sense the underlying stakes of a scene, you can add a d4 to the roll.
  • You can use this feature after you roll but before the GM tells you whether you succeed. Uses per Soma Break equal to your Soul value (minimum once).

(The Active Effect below also gives you a small numeric edge on Insight (Soul) and Perception (Mind) checks.)

Bound and Bargained

A sealed pact holds itself; you need only keep the terms.

Rules

While your Sealed Pact stance is active, the bindings carry part of your will for you: your Clarity maximum rises by 1.

Requires: Pactkeeper⚙ Applies automatically while the Sealed Pact stance is active: Clarity max +1.

Stability without stagnation; pressure without cruelty.

When a friendly creature within 6 squares of you fails a defense check against being Shaken, you can use your reaction to steady them.

  • The creature rerolls the defense check and must use the new result.
  • You can use this feature a number of times equal to your tier, and you regain all expended uses when you finish a Soma Break.

Strategic Layer. Once per turn, when your Domain spends marks to prevent a rebellion or unrest event in a Loyal hex, you may reduce that specific cost by 10 marks (minimum 10). This represents the quiet confidence your presence anchors.

activation.condition: When an ally within 30 ft fails a fear save.

description.value:
“We move, but we do not break.”

As a bonus action, you can mark one ally within 6 squares who can see or hear you.

  • Until the start of your next turn, that ally gains a +1 bonus to Guard and a +1 bonus to all defense checks against being Shaken or charmed.
  • If they succeed on any such save while this bonus is active, they also gain temporary Integrity equal to your tier.

You can use this feature a number of times equal to your tier, regaining all expended uses when you finish a Soma Break.
Extra Attack. When you spend your action to Strike, you may Strike twice instead of once.

Battlefield Presence

People fight better when you are near.

Rules

Allies within 2 squares of you reroll the lowest die on the first defense checks they make against being Shaken or charmed each combat.

✍ Aura — the GM applies the reroll to the allies' first defense checks against Shaken or charm each combat.

You define where the front actually is.

  • Allies within 2 squares of you ignore the first 1 square of forced movement each round (pushes, pulls, slides, and similar effects).
  • Allies within 2 squares of you gain a +1 bonus to their attribute checks made to maintain Clarity hold on a manifestation or effect.

Your presence makes frantic retreats into orderly repositioning instead.

aura.note: Hold the Line — allies within 2 squares ignore 1 square of forced movement; +1 to Clarity-hold checks (GM applies)

description.value: Attrition Easer. Once per turn, during your Domain’s planning phase, you may spend 10 Soft Power marks to remove 1 point of Attrition from your Domain, to a minimum of 0. This represents rest cycles, counseling, conflict resolution, and the very boring but vital work of actually processing the trauma.

Unity Field. Your conviction radiates outward like a stabilizing field.

  • While you are conscious, you emit a 2 squares aura. Allies in the aura (including you) reroll the lowest die on defense checks against being charmed or Shaken.
  • Once per turn when a creature starts its turn in your aura, you can grant it temporary Integrity equal to your Presence value (no action required).

(The Active Effect marks you as projecting the Unity Field aura; GMs and scripts can key off this flag.)

Negotiated Advantage. You can derail a hostile act mid-motion with a word, a look, or a sudden reframing.

  • When a creature you can see within 6 squares makes an attack roll or attribute check against you or an ally, you can use your reaction to impose roll 3d10 keep lowest 2 on that roll, as you disrupt the moment with a sharp interjection.
  • You can use this feature a number of times per Soma Break equal to your Presence value (minimum once).

Anchor Point

The world pushes. You remain.

Rules

You reroll the lowest die on checks or saves made to resist being pushed, pulled, knocked prone, Shaken, or charmed.

⚙ Reroll-lowest on checks and defense checks; the push / pull / prone / Shaken / charm gate is read by the GM.

Crisis Mediator. You specialize in talking people down from the brink.

  • When you resolve a significant scene that could have become a combat encounter (or escalated to violence) using primarily Diplomacy, Performance (Presence), Insight (Soul), or other nonviolent means, you may apply one of the following effects, as appropriate to the fiction:
  • • Darkness –1 in the affected hex or faction (to a campaign-appropriate minimum).
  • • +10 Soft Power marks to your Domain at the end of the turn.

You can apply this feature once per scene, and a number of times per Soma Break equal to your tier.

Voice of the Mandate. Your voice now carries not just your own authority, but the weight of your Domain’s mandate.

  • Allies within 6 squares of you who can hear you gain a +1 bonus to defense checks against being Shaken or charmed, and to last stand checks.
  • On the strategic layer, once per turn when you personally participate in a Parley, Battle, Heist, or other opposed Domain operation, you can grant your side a +1 bonus to one opposed roll representing speeches, appeals, or visible leadership.

“We’re going to step forward now. No one panics.”

As a bonus action, you may choose one ally within 6 squares who can see or hear you.

  • That ally can immediately move up to 2 squares without provoking reaction strikes.
  • Until the start of your next turn, that ally gains a +1 bonus to Guard.

This is not a charge; it’s a deliberate advance.

“You were never alone in your body.”

Archetype (Bad Eden): The Moon (Ancient Blood). You carry something older than law. Memory moves through you. It expects to matter.

Archetype Effects

  • Faction Edge. Your presence amplifies symbolism, inherited legitimacy, buried memory, and eerie cultural authority. Your Domain earns +10 Soft Power marks each turn while you serve it.
  • Tier Engine. See this Archetype’s Tier feats (Tier 1–4) for your full tactical and strategic toolkit; those are granted automatically by the Tier Engine at the appropriate character levels.
